backlog.q1.title: The analysis delay
backlog.q1.subtitle: Share of new CVEs the NVD analyzed within 7, 30 and 90 days of publication, by month, since January 2020
backlog.q1.sql:
-- Q1: CVEs published per month since January 2020, rejected excluded, and the share the NVD
-- analyzed within 7, 30 and 90 days among those old enough to be judged at each horizon.
select
    published_month,
    count(*) as cves,
    count(analyzed_7d) as judged_7d,
    avg(cast(analyzed_7d as integer)) as share_7d,
    count(analyzed_30d) as judged_30d,
    avg(cast(analyzed_30d as integer)) as share_30d,
    count(analyzed_90d) as judged_90d,
    avg(cast(analyzed_90d as integer)) as share_90d,
    count(first_analysis_at) as analyzed,
    median(days_to_analysis) as median_days_if_analyzed,
    count(*) filter (where analysis_undated) as analysis_undated
from gold.mart_backlog_q1
group by published_month
order by published_month

provenance.population: CVEs published since 2020-01-01, rejected CVEs excluded; every window (a descriptive count); a CVE is judged at k days only once k days have passed

backlog.q2.title: After the change
backlog.q2.subtitle: New CVEs since 15 April 2026 by NVD status, and how fast the NVD analyzes the ones in KEV
backlog.q2.sql:
-- Q2: CVEs published since 2026-04-15 by NVD status, and the KEV listed among them with the
-- hours from listing to the first NVD analysis at or after the listing.
select
    nvd_status,
    count(*) as cves,
    count(*) filter (where nvd_analyzed) as analyzed,
    count(*) filter (where kev_listed) as kev_listed,
    count(*) filter (where kev_listed and analyzed_before_listing) as kev_analyzed_before_listing,
    median(hours_listing_to_analysis) as median_hours_listing_to_analysis
from gold.mart_backlog_q2
group by nvd_status
order by cves desc

provenance.population: CVEs published since 2026-04-15; the shadow window, from 2026-04-15 to the data cut

backlog.q3.title: What the filer gives instead
backlog.q3.subtitle: For CVEs the NVD has not analyzed: the share with a filer CVSS, a CWE, affected versions or a CISA ADP value
backlog.q3.sql:
-- Q3: for CVEs the NVD has not analyzed, what the filer and CISA supplied, for the twenty filers
-- with the most such CVEs.
select
    filer,
    any_value(filer_type) as filer_type,
    count(*) as cves,
    avg(cast(has_filer_cvss3 as integer)) as filer_cvss3,
    avg(cast(has_filer_cvss40 as integer)) as filer_cvss40,
    avg(cast(has_filer_cwe as integer)) as filer_cwe,
    avg(cast(has_affected_versions as integer)) as affected_versions,
    avg(cast(has_adp_value as integer)) as cisa_adp_value
from gold.mart_backlog_q3
group by filer
order by cves desc, filer
limit 20

provenance.population: CVEs without NVD analysis, rejected CVEs excluded, every window; every window (a descriptive count)

backlog.q4.title: Can a filer score stand in for the NVD
backlog.q4.subtitle: Agreement between the filer's CVSS 3.1 vector and the NVD's, metric by metric and on the band
backlog.q4.sql:
-- Q4: CVEs both the filer and the NVD scored with CVSS 3.1 (train, development and shadow
-- windows), how often each base metric and the band agree, by filer type.
select
    filer_type,
    count(*) as cves,
    avg(cast(nvd_av = filer_av as integer)) as agree_av,
    avg(cast(nvd_ac = filer_ac as integer)) as agree_ac,
    avg(cast(nvd_pr = filer_pr as integer)) as agree_pr,
    avg(cast(nvd_ui = filer_ui as integer)) as agree_ui,
    avg(cast(nvd_s = filer_s as integer)) as agree_s,
    avg(cast(nvd_c = filer_c as integer)) as agree_c,
    avg(cast(nvd_i = filer_i as integer)) as agree_i,
    avg(cast(nvd_a = filer_a as integer)) as agree_a,
    avg(cast(nvd_band = filer_band as integer)) as agree_band
from gold.mart_filer_vs_nvd
group by filer_type
order by cves desc

provenance.population: CVEs scored with CVSS 3.1 by both their filer and the NVD, rejected excluded; train, development and shadow only (never test, never the gap)

backlog.q5.title: Exploited, and when
backlog.q5.subtitle: KEV listed CVEs published since 2021: days to listing, NVD analysis at the moment of listing, exploit code before it
backlog.q5.sql:
-- Q5: KEV listed CVEs published since 2021, days from publication to listing, the NVD status
-- as of the moment of listing, and exploit code seen before the listing.
select
    date_trunc('year', published) as published_year,
    count(*) as cves,
    median(days_to_listing) as median_days_to_listing,
    avg(cast(days_to_listing <= 30 as integer)) as listed_within_30_days,
    avg(cast(not nvd_analyzed_at_listing as integer)) as no_nvd_analysis_at_listing,
    avg(cast(exploit_before_listing as integer)) as exploit_code_before_listing
from gold.mart_kev_timing
group by 1
order by 1

provenance.population: KEV listed CVEs published since 2021-01-01, listings dated before publication (Q03) excluded; every window (a descriptive count)

backlog.q6.title: Who files the flood
backlog.q6.subtitle: Monthly CVE volume by filer and filer type since 2020, and the filers behind the growth
backlog.q6.sql:
-- Q6: CVEs published since 2020 by month and filer type, with each type's share of the month.
select
    published_month,
    filer_type,
    sum(cves) as cves,
    sum(cves) / any_value(month_total) as share_of_month
from gold.mart_backlog_q6
group by published_month, filer_type
order by published_month, filer_type

provenance.population: CVEs published since 2020-01-01; every window; growth from 2020 to the twelve months 2025-11-01 to 2026-11-01 (end excluded)

backlog.q8.title: How different the skipped CVEs are
backlog.q8.subtitle: How well a logistic regression tells the CVEs the NVD analyzed from the ones it skipped, shadow window
backlog.q8.sql:
-- Q8: the shadow window, the registered features and the label, split by time into the half
-- the classifier is fitted on and the half it is scored on.
select
    half,
    count(*) as cves,
    avg(cast(nvd_analyzed as integer)) as share_analyzed,
    min(published) as first_published,
    max(published) as last_published
from gold.mart_domain_shift
group by half
order by min(position)
